scope: The Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum’s main exhibition building and its Zhimei pedestrian bridge in Taibao, as seen on the day after the museum’s December 2015 soft opening.

references.filename: Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum main building and zhimei bridge.jpg

originalReview.notes: Wide side view fixes the dark arched span, thin closely spaced ribs, low deck, three sculptural museum volumes and gray east glazing.

references.filename: Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum zhimei bridge.jpg

originalReview.notes: The bridge close view records the thick single steel box arch, splayed fins, low mesh balustrade, broad paving, curved approach and abutments.

quallaSearch.notes: Used two exact Qualla originals from the same visit. The Commons local rename log confirms the credited photographer and the uploader are the same account.
